arguments.text: PLAN (min 1): 8000 m, 8 legs x 1000 m out-and-back. CP boat 129 W / shaft 205 W (test, may be 10-25 pct off). Start hot: 163 W, reserve 77 pct at 1 min. Aim: settle near CP (shaft ~205-210 W) by min 3, hold even, keep reserve ~15-25 pct for last 1000 m, finish sprint from ~600-800 m left. Headwind/current against on leg 1 (push_along -0.16), so leg 2 should be with it; do not judge paddler by GPS speed alone.

arguments.condition: elapsed_s > 200 and shaft_power_w > 1.10 * cp_shaft_w and remaining_m > 1200
arguments.message: Shaft power over 110 pct of CP after the start settled

arguments.condition: elapsed_s > 200 and shaft_power_w < 0.90 * cp_shaft_w and remaining_m > 900
arguments.message: Shaft power under 90 pct of CP: easing too much or fading
Pod reserve below 35 pct with more than 2.5 km to go
Boat-speed reserve falling well below pod reserve: drag, current or blade, not the paddler
About 1100 m to go: plan the finish

arguments.text: Watches set at min 1: too_hot (shaft >110 pct CP 45 s after 200 s), too_easy (shaft <90 pct CP 45 s), reserve_low_early (pod reserve <35 pct with >2.5 km left), drag_split (boat reserve 15 pts below pod reserve: drag/rudder/current), finish_zone (<1100 m left). No cue at start: let the hard start settle by itself; check at next wake-up that shaft power came down to ~205-215 W.

text: no cue: hard start is expected to settle on its own; plan noted and five watches set to wake me on overpacing, easing, early reserve loss, drag, and the finish.

arguments.text: Good start. Settle now, long way to go, ease to race pace.

arguments.message: Boat slower than pod power predicts beyond the fitted current: rudder weed, drag, or a current change

arguments.text: Min 4: still hot after start: shaft 225 W (110 pct CP), boat 147 W; pod reserve 45 pct, boat reserve 19 pct (two models disagree: boat W prime 7.3 kJ is small vs pod 18.8 kJ; fitted push -0.11 vs local -0.04 may inflate boat power). Cued EASE (no pace target, out-and-back current makes ground pace misleading). Target shaft ~205-210 W. Replaced drag_split watch (fired on model mismatch) with drag_local (push_local minus push_along < -0.22 for 30 s).

text: Cued ease: shaft power 110 pct of critical power at min 4 with pod reserve at 45 pct and 7.2 km left; swapped the drag watch for one on local push.

arguments.message: Pod reserve below 22 pct with more than 2 km to go

arguments.text: Nice work. Take one small notch off, long smooth strokes.

Min 7 (leg 2, current helping +0.16): first ease took shaft 225 to 216 W. Boat reserve reads 0 but speed fade only -1.8 pct, so boat model (W prime 7.3 kJ) looks too pessimistic; trust POD reserve (34 pct, sustainable shaft 208 W). Paddler: 6/10 hard but holding. Cued small EASE again (on a with-current leg, cheaper to ease here). Avoid ground-pace targets: they carry through turns into the current. Check cp_implied_w after ~min 14 to correct boat CP. reserve_low_early watch now <22 pct with >2 km left.

text: Cued a small ease: shaft power still 6 pct over critical power, pod reserve 34 pct with 6.6 km left; paddler says 6/10.

arguments.condition: elapsed_s > 200 and shaft_power_w > 1.07 * cp_shaft_w and remaining_m > 1200
arguments.message: Shaft power over 107 pct of CP for a minute
Pod reserve below 15 pct with more than 2.5 km to go

arguments.text: Min 10 (turning into leg 3, against current -0.18): shaft 212-215 W (sustainable 208), pod reserve 27 pct, draining ~2.5 pts/min. Two eases had small effect (225 to 212). PLAN: spend a bit more against the current (hold ~212-215 W on odd legs), ease to ~203-205 W on with-current even legs; aim pod reserve ~15-20 pct at 1.1 km left for the sprint. No cue at min 10. Watches tightened: too_hot = shaft >107 pct CP 60 s; reserve_low_early = pod <15 pct with >2.5 km left.

text: no cue: shaft power only ~2 pct above sustainable and the next leg is against the current, where a little extra effort pays; watches tightened.

arguments.reason: Boat reserve has read 0 since about min 5 while the paddler held ~140 W boat / ~217 W shaft for 8+ min with no speed fade at the same rate (fade ~0 to -2.8 pct) and reports 6/10 twice; a paddler cannot hold above CP on an empty reserve, so CP is about 8 pct above the test value. Conservative correction.

arguments.text: Min 13: pod reserve 14 pct (old CP), shaft 216-222 W against current, no fade, paddler 6/10 again. Boat reserve 0 since min 5 at ~140 W with no fade = CP underestimated. SET CP boat 138 W, shaft 214 W (1 of 3 corrections). No cue. Next: if speed fades or shaft power sags involuntarily, CP was right after all; ease then. On with-current legs (even) ease toward ~210 W; against current (odd) ~218-222 W ok.

text: no cue: raised critical power to 138 W boat / 214 W shaft because the paddler has held above the old value on an empty boat reserve for 8 min without fading; effort is right for an against-current leg.

arguments.text: Halfway, strong work. Relax with the current, save some.

arguments.name: eff_ratio
arguments.description: share of shaft power reaching the boat (normal ~0.64-0.65)

arguments.message: Boat power share of shaft power below 0.60 for a minute: drag, rudder weed, or blade fading

arguments.text: Min 16 (leg 4, with current +0.13): shaft 220 W vs corrected CP 214 (sustainable 215), pod reserve 8 pct. Fade drifted -0.1 to -1.3 pct over leg 3 (slight). Cued EASE on the with-current leg. Removed reserve_low_early (would refire). New derived eff_ratio = power_w/shaft_power_w (normal ~0.645) and watch eff_drop (<0.60 for 60 s).

text: Cued a small ease on the with-current leg: shaft power 3 pct over corrected critical power with pod reserve at 8 pct and 4.9 km left; added a boat-efficiency watch.

arguments.text: Good recovery. Lift back to strong race rhythm for the turn.

Min 19 (leg 4, 279 m to turn): ease at min 16 overshot: shaft 220 to 205 W (below corrected CP 214, sustainable 215); pod reserve back to 10 pct; eff_ratio ~0.64 normal, so speed fade -3.9 pct is the lower power, not drag. Cued PUSH (small) to get back ~213-218 W before the against-current leg 5. Eases move ~5-15 W and take ~2 min; avoid stacking cues.

text: Cued a small push: the last ease overshot to 205 W, below the corrected critical power, with an against-current leg coming.

arguments.reason: Race committee radio at min 20.3: all boats, course extended by one leg, finish now at 9000 m.

arguments.text: Course extended one leg. Finish is five kilometres from here.

Min 20.3: RADIO race committee: course extended by one leg, finish now 9000 m (9 legs; the finish is at the far end, after an odd leg against the current?). Set race distance 9000 and told paddler 5000 m left. Pacing now: hold ~214-216 W shaft (at corrected CP), pod reserve ~11 pct; save the sprint for the last ~500-700 m. finish_zone watch uses remaining_m so now fires at 7900 m.

text: Radio said the course is now 9000 m: corrected the race distance and told the paddler the finish is 5 km away so they do not sprint at the old line.

arguments.text: Boat is dragging. Back-stroke to clear the rudder, then settle.

arguments.message: Check whether the rudder clear worked (power vs speed) and settle effort

arguments.text: Min 22.7 (leg 5, against current): shaft power ramped 217 to 269 W over ~100 s while GPS speed stayed flat ~3.11 and rate 62; eff_ratio 0.50 (normal 0.64), push_local -0.385 vs fitted -0.13; paddler now 9/10 (was 6). Pod reserve 0. Read as rudder weed / drag (not pod drift: paddler feels it). Cued CLEAR_RUDDER. Next: if power share back to ~0.64, cue ease to race rhythm (~214 W) to refill; if not, maybe current change instead.

text: Cued a rudder clear: shaft power rose 25 pct with no gain in speed and the paddler went from 6 to 9 out of 10, which points to something caught on the rudder; check set for 90 s later.
no cue: this drag alert is the same event I just cued a rudder clear for 6 s ago; waiting for the check watch.

arguments.text: Ease into steady race rhythm now, four kilometres to go.

arguments.message: Leg 6 started: compare GPS speed and pod power with leg 4 to tell pod drift from a current change

arguments.text: Min 24.7: rudder clear done (speed dip at min 23) but pod still 277-280 W, GPS flat 3.07-3.12, boat power 131 W (below boat CP 138, boat reserve refilling to 32 pct), push_local -0.41. Not weed. Suspect POD DRIFT (pod ramped 220 to 280 W with no speed gain, rate flat 62) or a stronger current against. Paddler 9 then 8/10 (fatigue?). Cued EASE (safe either way). TEST at leg 6 (with current): leg 4 had GPS ~3.34-3.38 at pod ~213-220 W. If GPS similar but pod still high = pod drift: then pace from boat speed / boat reserve, ignore pod and shaft watches.

text: Cued ease: the rudder clear did not change the 280 W pod reading at flat speed; easing is safe whether the pod is drifting or the paddler is really overdoing it, and the next leg will tell which.

arguments.text: Min 26.6 VERDICT: POD DRIFT. Leg 6 (with current) GPS ~3.35 = same as leg 4 at pod ~215 W, but pod reads 274 W; offset is the same both directions (so not a current change) and rudder clear changed nothing (not weed). IGNORE pod: shaft power, w_bal_pod_frac, push_local, eff_ratio. Pace from BOAT power (CP 138 W corrected) and boat reserve. Removed shaft watches; added boat_hot (>110 pct boat CP 60 s) and boat_easy (<91 pct 60 s). Now boat 132 W, boat reserve 44 pct; my ease at 24.8 is fading, natural effort was ~140 W. Sprint on leg 9 (last 1000 m, against current) from ~600-700 m left.

text: no cue: the paddle pod is drifting high (same speed as leg 4 at a 60 W higher reading), so I switched pacing and watches to boat speed; the paddler is just below boat critical power and my last ease is fading.

arguments.text: Strong and steady. Hold this rhythm into the current.

Min 29.6: boat power drifting down 132 to 128 W with no cue, fade -4.6 pct, paddler 9/10 (8 at min 24.7). Likely truly near empty: original test CP (boat 129) fits better than my raised 138, so the boat reserve (53 pct) is OVERSTATED; do not trust it for the sprint. Do not push now. Cued HOLD before leg 7 (against current). Finish plan: hold to the last turn (8000 m), then sprint only the last ~350-450 m of leg 9; a depleted paddler has little to spend.

text: Cued hold: the paddler is at 9 out of 10 and fading slowly at about the original critical power, so I want no further drop without risking a blow-up by pushing.

arguments.message: About 480 m to go: cue the finish sprint now

text: no cue: hold is working (boat power steady 127-131 W against the current); added a watch to wake me at 480 m to go for the finish sprint.
no cue: paddler holding a steady 127-131 W boat power near the original critical power; saving cues and reserve for the final leg sprint.

arguments.text: You are doing great. Ease a touch here, save it for home.

Min 37.5 (leg 8, with current, 1743 m left): paddler said legs going, close to the limit. Boat power 126-133 W at about original CP. Cued small EASE on the with-current leg to avoid a blow-up and keep something for the last leg into the current. At finish_zone (1100 m left, last turn ~8000 m): cue HOLD/steady into the current; at sprint_point (480 m): cue FINISH.

text: Cued a small ease with reassurance: paddler reports being near the limit; easing on the with-current leg is the cheapest place to save for the final leg and sprint.

arguments.text: Last turn coming. Build back to strong rhythm for home.

Min 39.2 (1414 m left, 414 m to last turn): ease overshot, boat power 117 W (~91 pct of original CP 129), so paddler is refilling. Cued PUSH back to ~CP for the last leg into the current. Removed finish_zone and boat_easy watches (redundant now). Next wake: sprint_point at 480 m left: cue FINISH.

text: Cued a push: the ease dropped boat power to 91 pct of critical power, so the paddler has recovered a little and the last leg into the current is where effort pays most.
